## Describe the Feature
Clear & concise description of what the feature adalah.

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
Clear description of the problem.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
Description of the solution Anda bayangkan.

## Alternative Solutions
Any other solutions or features Anda consider?

## Additional Context

- Use case?
- Who would benefit?
- How urgent/important?

## Checklist

- [ ] Feature ini clearly defined
- [ ] Sudah check existing features
- [ ] Aligned dengan project scope
